jobs.title: Growth Product Manager (PLG)
jobs.description:
About Higgsfield

Higgsfield.ai http://Higgsfield.ai is the fastest-growing generative AI platform in the world. Creators use Higgsfield to produce video, images, and interactive content with 200+ frontier models — and they do it at a scale few consumer products ever reach: we grew revenue 3x in the last four months and crossed $700M in annualized GAAP revenue by July 2026.

We recently closed a $500M funding round at a $5B valuation to accelerate what's working. The company is small relative to its revenue, decisions are fast, and the distance between an idea and production is measured in days - we ship 80+ releases a month.


About the role

You will own product-led growth at Higgsfield: making the product itself our biggest acquisition channel. Referral mechanics, viral loops, shareable artifacts, and agentic distribution — we were among the first in the world to sell subscriptions directly inside AI assistants via MCP, and that channel already drives a meaningful share of our new plan purchases. Your job is to engineer growth that compounds without a marketing budget.

We are looking for a builder, not an optimizer. There is no PLG playbook for consumer AI — you will be writing it. You should be comfortable shaping strategy without precedent, shipping daily, and defending your calls with numbers. This is a hands-on A-level role with founder-level visibility, on the Product Growth team — the team that owns all of Higgsfield's revenue.


Key responsibilities

• Design and ship referral mechanics end-to-end: incentive structures, anti-abuse, unit economics per referral, GAAP-compliant reward design — prioritizing defensible economics over headline signup numbers.

• Build viral loops into the product: shareable generation artifacts, watermark-to-signup flows, social-embedded distribution — so that every piece of content our users publish works as acquisition surface.

• Own the mobile PLG motion — desktop is our revenue platform; mobile is our acquisition engine. You design the viral-first experiences that feed the funnel.

• Scale agentic distribution: grow our MCP/assistant-embedded channel — funnel and product experience for users who arrive through AI agents rather than browsers.

• Run a rigorous experiment pipeline: hypothesis → test → ship → measure, at a pace of multiple experiments per week — raising the team's experimentation velocity and rigor over time.

• Own your metrics and their story: viral coefficient (K-factor), referral-attributed revenue, CAC of product channels vs. paid, activation of referred cohorts — and communicate what we tested, what we learned, and what it's worth to the business.


Minimum qualifications

• A track record of personally moving revenue or acquisition metrics — you can name the number, the mechanism, and your specific role in it, rather than pointing to team outcomes.

• Shipped viral or referral features in consumer products — and can walk us through the incentive design, what got abused, and how you closed the holes.

• An experimentation program behind you with a clear ROI story rather than a backlog of A/B tests — test design, guard metrics, and honest reads of ambiguous results.

• Unit-economics fluency: you think in CAC, ARPU, payback, and contribution margin — growth that bleeds margin is not growth you ship.

• Full command of your data: you build your own funnels and dashboards, pull your own queries, and never wait for an analyst to tell you what happened.

• Comfort operating at startup speed: weekly ship cadence, decisions with 70% of the data, and the judgment to know which 30% can wait.

 

Preferred qualifications

• 3–6+ years in growth or product roles at consumer technology companies.

• Consumer AI, creative tools, or credits-economy experience.

• Experience with agentic ecosystems.

• Mobile growth background (app store funnels, mobile-first virality).

 

Why this role is special

• You'll build PLG for a product people already want to share — generative content is inherently viral raw material.

• The agentic channel is a genuinely new distribution paradigm — you'll be defining playbooks that don't exist yet.

• Impact measured in millions — not decks.

 

What we offer

• Competitive compensation with meaningful equity at a $5B-valuation, hyper-growth company.
• A team that owns its P&L end-to-end — you will see your work in the revenue numbers within weeks, not quarters.
• Direct access to founders and leadership; zero layers between you and the decision.  
• Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country.
• Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits.

This is a fully on-site role based in our Almaty office. Our team works from the office five days per week for the full working day. We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Lifecycle & Retention
jobs.description:
About Higgsfield

Higgsfield.ai http://Higgsfield.ai is the fastest-growing generative AI platform in the world. Creators use Higgsfield to produce video, images, and interactive content with 200+ frontier models — and they do it at a scale few consumer products ever reach: we grew revenue 3x in the last three months and crossed $700M in annualized GAAP revenue by July 2026.

We recently closed a $500M funding round at a $5B valuation to accelerate what's working. The company is small relative to its revenue, decisions are fast, and the distance between an idea and production is measured in days — we ship 80+ releases a month.


About the role

You will own the paying-user lifecycle end-to-end: activating new subscribers into habitual users, growing consumers into prosumers, protecting rebills, reducing voluntary and involuntary churn, and running systematic winback. In a consumer AI market where median retention is brutal, retention is our sharpest competitive weapon — and this role is its owner.

We are looking for someone who treats retention as an engineering problem, not a campaign calendar. You should be comfortable going from cohort triangles to shipped products in the same week, and defending every claimed win with honest attribution. We need someone who understands the complete behavioral picture behind them: why users buy, why they leave, where they go, and what brings them back. PLG built on that understanding compounds; PLG built on acquisition alone leaks. This is a hands-on A-level role on the Product Growth team — the team that owns all of Higgsfield's revenue — with direct impact on the largest line items in our P&L.


Key responsibilities

• Own activation: onboarding flows, aha-moment design, time-to-first-value — turning day-0 subscribers into week-4 habitual users.

• Build engagement systems: tasks, streaks, rewards, and the notifications platform that moves users up the consumer → prosumer ladder — prioritizing durable habit formation over one-offengagement spikes.

• Own churn end-to-end: voluntary (cancellation flows, save offers, plan right-sizing) and involuntary (dunning, payment recovery, grace periods).

• Run winback as a system, not a campaign: offer architecture, timing models, and channel orchestration for cancelled and dormant cohorts — reactivation already contributes millions in MRR monthly, and it's still under-engineered.

• Drive expansion: upsells, plan upgrades, and credit top-up purchase frequency from engaged cohorts.

• Go deep on users: full-profile research, behavioral segmentation, cohort deep-dives — your insights feed every team in Product Growth.

• Partner with lifecycle marketing: email/push triggers and content built on the segments and signals you define

 

Minimum qualifications

• A track record of personally owning retention, churn, or engagement metrics in a subscription business — you can name the curve you bent and the mechanism that bent it, rather than pointing to team outcomes.

• Deep command of subscription mechanics: rebills, dunning, involuntary churn, grace flows, save offers — you know which churn gets fixed with product and which gets fixed with payments infrastructure, and you don't confuse the two.

• Cohort-analysis fluency: retention curves, survival analysis, segmentation — you read triangles like others read dashboards, and you distrust any aggregate that hasn't been decomposed.

• Built habit-forming mechanics (streaks, rewards, notifications) with quantified results — durable retention lift rather than short-lived engagement theater.

• Measurement discipline: weekly experiments, honest attribution, guard metrics — a claimed win you can't defend under scrutiny is worse than no win.

• Full command of your data: you build your own cohorts and queries, and never wait for an analyst to tell you what happened.

 

Preferred qualifications

• 3–6+ years in product or growth roles in subscription businesses.

• Consumer AI, performance marketing, gaming, or credits-economy background (usage-based engagement patterns).

• Experience with payment orchestration / recovery tooling.

• Worked with CRM/lifecycle-marketing platforms at scale.

 

Why this role is special

• Retention in consumer AI is an unsolved problem industry-wide — solving it here is a career-defining case study.

• The winback opportunity alone is one of the highest-ROI surfaces in the company — and it's yours on day one.

• Full ownership of your metrics, and a team culture where impact is measured in revenue — not process.

 

What we offer

• Competitive compensation with meaningful equity at a $5B-valuation, hyper-growth company.

• A team that owns its P&L end-to-end — you will see your work in the revenue numbers within weeks, not quarters.

• Direct access to founders and leadership; zero layers between you and the decision.

• Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country.
• Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits.

This is a fully on-site role based in our Almaty office. Our team works from the office five days per week for the full working day. We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Core Product)
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI? 

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

Why this role exists
Higgsfield is one of the fastest-growing generative AI companies in the world. The specialty studios get most of the attention, but the general-purpose creation surface, the library, the shared foundation every user touches, is what makes or breaks daily use. We need a PM with real taste to own it.

What you'll actually do
• Own the core product experience end-to-end: image, video, collaboration, asset management, and the overall UX that ties them together.
• Own the surrounding product: library, projects, sharing, cross-product navigation, the things that make Higgsfield feel like one product instead of a bag of tools.
• Set the taste bar. Every flow, every empty state, every default. You're the person the team looks to when something feels off.
• Ship weekly. Our release cycle is days, not quarters.
• Design the metrics that matter: activation, generation success rate, session depth, weekly retention, feature adoption, cross-product usage.
• Glue the org together on the core experience. Work directly with Design, Backend, Frontend, and the vertical studio teams so the surface stays coherent as new products land on top of it.

Must-haves

 1. Deep passion and curiosity for generative image, video, and LLMs. You use these tools daily. You have opinions about which models are good at what, and why.

 2. Taste. You can look at a flow and tell what's wrong before the metric moves. Design and Engineering both trust your judgment.

 3. Experience launching new products and scaling existing ones. You've taken things from zero to one and from one to ten. Founding or early-operator experience is a strong plus.

 4. Strong technical background with a real grasp of AI/ML concepts. You can reason about model tradeoffs, latency, quality, and cost without needing an engineer to translate.

 5. You ask smart questions, dig for answers yourself, and update your view when the evidence moves. No ego on the line when you're wrong.

Who this is not for
• You prefer working from complete specifications rather than defining problems yourself.
• You don't use generative AI tools daily. This role is impossible without lived product intuition.
• You are looking for a slower release cycle. We ship weekly.

Nice to have
• Background at a consumer product, creative tool, or AI-native company in the US, EU, or Asia.
• Direct experience shipping image or video generation, editing, or creative software.

What We Offer

 - Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

 - Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country.

 - A seat where the surface you own is what millions of users touch every day.

 - A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

 - Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

 - Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits.

This is a fully on-site role based in our Almaty office. Our team works from the office five days per week for the full working day. We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI? 

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to serve as a critical bridge between our customers and our Product and Engineering teams.

You'll own complex technical customer inquiries from end to end—understanding what customers are trying to accomplish, investigating issues, coordinating with the right technical teams, and driving requests through resolution.

You'll develop a deep understanding of Higgsfield's products, APIs, models, and technical infrastructure while identifying patterns across customer feedback that can help improve our products and customer experience at scale.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own technical customer inquiries and escalations from initial request through resolution.

 - Become deeply knowledgeable about Higgsfield's products, models, APIs, capabilities, and technical workflows.

 - Investigate and troubleshoot customer issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with Engineering and Product to drive resolution.

 - Partner closely with Engineering and Product to prioritize high-impact customer issues and ensure timely follow-through.

 - Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Trust & Safety)
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI? 

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

Why this role exists
Higgsfield is one of the fastest-growing generative AI companies in the world. Every generation is a policy decision at scale, and the surface area (NSFW, IP, likeness, anti-fraud, deepfakes, regional law) grows every week. Trust & Safety needs a PM who can turn ambiguous legal, policy, and financial-abuse inputs into shipped systems, not another doc.

What you'll actually do
• Own the T&S product surface end-to-end: classifiers, appeals, user-facing warnings, moderator tooling, enforcement flows.
• Own anti-fraud alongside content safety: multi-account farms, free-trial abuse, refund abuse, chargebacks, prompt-injection cost exploits, reseller wrappers. Fraud is a large and growing share of the T&S problem here.
• Translate legal, policy, and financial-risk requirements into concrete product specs the ML and engineering teams can build against.
• Set thresholds and enforcement policy in partnership with Applied ML: what gets blocked, what gets warned, what gets appealed, and the dollar and reputational tradeoffs behind each choice.
• Run the incident loop when something breaks in production, provider escalations, misuse incidents, fraud spikes, new abuse vectors, and ship the fix.
• Design the metrics that matter: dollars saved from fraud, false-positive cost to legit users, false-negative legal exposure, appeal reversal rate, coverage across new models and markets.
• Work directly with Legal, Applied ML, Backend, Growth, Payments, and external providers to keep our contractual and regulatory obligations current.

Must-haves

 1. Founding or early-operator experience. You've spent years trying to build something of your own. You know what it's like to own an outcome when nobody hands you a spec.

 2. Shipped T&S, moderation, fraud, risk, or compliance products at scale. You've made real enforcement decisions that affected real users and real money.

 3. Comfort with legal, policy, and financial-risk ambiguity. You've worked with counsel, payments providers, or regulators and translated their inputs into product.

 4. Strong technical judgment. You can reason about classifier tradeoffs, fraud-detection tradeoffs, threshold selection, and evaluation without needing an engineer to translate.

 5. You make decisions in dollars and risk, not opinions. A block rate has a cost, a miss has a cost, a false fraud flag has a cost, you can argue all sides.

Who this is not for
• You prefer working from complete specifications rather than defining problems yourself.
• You want to write strategy docs more than ship enforcement changes.
• You are looking for a slower release cycle. We ship weekly, and incidents can compress that to hours.

Nice to have
• Background at a generative AI, UGC platform, marketplace, or fintech risk team in the US, EU, or Asia.
• Direct experience with C2PA, child safety classifiers, IP takedowns, DMCA, GDPR enforcement, chargeback flows, or 3DS.
• Comfort with adversarial abuse patterns and how they evolve.

What We Offer

 - Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

 - Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country.

jobs.title: Data Science, Product Analyst
jobs.description:
WHY WORK AT HIGGSFIELD AI? 

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.



WHAT THIS ROLE MEANS AT HIGGSFIELD

This role owns how Higgsfield measures its product - from the first sign-up to whether people come back.

You are the measurement owner for onboarding, first generation, the paywall, plans and credits, and retention. Product managers ship fast here - your job is to make sure they ship knowing.

You make sure:

 - Every product decision has a number attached to it before it ships and after it ships

 - Experiments are designed to be readable, and then read honestly - including when the answer is “this didn’t work”

 - The events the product emits can be trusted; you own the definition, not just the query

 - A PM gets an answer in hours, not next sprint

You are the person who decides what “it worked” means.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Product measurement

 - Own the core product metrics: activation, first-generation success, generation depth, free→paid conversion, repeat usage, retention by cohort and segment.

 - Define each metric once, write the definition down, and hold the line on it - one definition across dashboards, decks, and Slack.

 - Instrument new features before launch, with product and engineering: which events, which properties, what success looks like, when we call it.

 - Watch the health of the event stream itself - tracking drift, double counting, missing parameters, naming breakage and find the problem before a decision gets made on top of it.

Experimentation

 - Design A/B tests properly: hypothesis, one primary metric, unit of randomization, MDE, sample size, run length, guardrail metrics.

 - Read them honestly: significance, peeking, novelty effects, sample-ratio mismatch, segment heterogeneity.

 - Separate “we proved this works,” “we proved this doesn’t,” and “we can’t tell from this test” - and say which one out loud.

Product & monetization analysis

 - In-product funnel work: onboarding and quiz, first generation, paywall, checkout, plan choice, credit top-ups.

 - Pricing and packaging analysis: plan mix, credit consumption, unit economics per generation, margin by feature and by model.

 - Feature adoption and its real effect on retention and revenue — separating “users who do X retain better” from “making people do X improves retention.”

 - Behavioural segmentation: casual creators vs corporate/B2B, new vs returning, by model and by use case. Mixing them hides everything that matters.

Making it usable

 - Build the few dashboards PMs actually open on their own — decision-shaped, not comprehensive.

 - Write short readouts a non-analyst can act on. Visualize data for humans, not for other analysts.

 - Automate recurring reporting so your hours go to new questions, not refreshes.

 - Work in SQL, Python, BigQuery and product analytics tools. We use AI heavily - resourcefulness beats syntax.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for an analyst with opinions.

You should have:

 - Strong SQL: window functions, cohorts, funnels and retention on raw event data, without help.

 - Python at working level for analysis (pandas, notebooks). Entry level is fine - we use AI heavily.

 - Real experimentation experience: you have designed tests, run them, and killed features with the results.

 - Statistical honesty: you know what a p-value does and does not entitle you to say, and you have refused to call a flat test a win.

 - Understanding of subscription + one-time purchase mechanics: recurring vs one-off revenue, refunds, plan changes, deferred value of unspent credits.

 - The instinct to check the instrument before explaining the movement - a surprising number is a claim, not a fact.

 - Ownership: you decide what's worth analyzing, you chase the fix, you follow the recommendation to a shipped change.

 - Clear written and spoken English, B2+.

Backgrounds that often do well:

 - Product analysts from consumer subscription or PLG products

 - Growth/BI analysts who moved into product and stayed

 - Early-startup analysts who built product measurement from zero

 - Data scientists who got tired of models and want decisions


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This role is not a fit if you:

 - Wait for a ticket to tell you what to analyze

 - Want to build models more than you want to change decisions

 - Need a data engineering team and clean tables to exist before you can start

 - Would report a lift you don't believe in because a stakeholder wants it

 - Need perfect data before you can say anything useful

 - Want predictable 9–5 workdays


HIRING PROCESS

We move fast:

 1. Screening call (30 min)

 2. Technical interview & case study (1 hour)

 3. Practical home task (7 days)

 4. Team interview (60 min)

 5. Paid on-site trial (1 month)



WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

 - Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country.

 - A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

 - Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

 - Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits.
